parts.name: Frame
parts.Basic_description: The frame of the clock is made of plastic and forms the outer boundary of the clock, providing structural support.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the clock surface, mechanism, and glass cover in place, protecting internal components.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed part and does not move during operation.

parts.name: Hour Hand
parts.Basic_description: The hour hand is a small aluminum pointer that indicates the hour on the clock face.
parts.Functional_description: It rotates slowly around the clock center to show the current hour.
parts.Movement_description: It moves rotationally around the central axis at a slow, constant rate.

parts.name: Minute Hand
parts.Basic_description: The minute hand is a longer aluminum pointer that indicates the minutes on the clock face.
parts.Functional_description: It rotates around the clock center to show the current minute.
parts.Movement_description: It moves rotationally around the central axis at a moderate, continuous rate.

parts.name: Second Hand
parts.Basic_description: The second hand is a thin aluminum pointer that indicates the seconds on the clock face.
parts.Functional_description: It rotates around the clock center to show the passing seconds.
parts.Movement_description: It moves rotationally around the central axis at a fast, continuous or ticking rate.

parts.name: Surface
parts.Basic_description: The surface of the clock is a glass cover that protects the hands and face of the clock.
parts.Functional_description: It provides a clear view of the clock face while protecting internal components from dust and damage.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed part and does not move during operation.
